name: Maps - basic Google map
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Maps - basic Google map.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Configure your real location, coverage and contact information. Native links open Google Maps; embeds load external content. The theme does not verify addresses, coverage, opening hours or service availability. Blank location fields do not select a sample place.

settings.label: Map mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for map mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Google maps embed code (iframe)
settings.how: Write the google maps embed code (iframe). Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.
